key_insight: Amortized moment matching learns distribution moments with neural networks, turning Fréchet-style statistical matching into a scalable, conditional, and matrix-free training objective for generation.
engineering_relevance: The method provides a practical post-training loss for high-dimensional generative models, improving stability and enabling stronger one-step image and text-to-image generation without explicit moment computation.
method: Uses polynomial projections of diffusion denoisers to identify data moments up to order n+1.
Instantiates an Amortized Fréchet Distance (AMFD) loss that learns conditional moments via alternating optimization.
Operates on global representation features to support efficient post-training and direct exploration in native latent spaces.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports stronger performance than the FD baseline on FDr^6, superior one-step ImageNet generation, and state-of-the-art instruction-following gains on GenEval for text-to-image models.
watch_item: Because AMFD relies on learned conditional moments and representation quality, its effectiveness may depend on the chosen feature space and careful optimization tuning.
paper_title: Amortized Moment Matching for Visual Generation
